name: core-runtime-static-resource-callout-mocks-wave17-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: Static resource callout mocks require Apex test context and are recorded as local-runtime-only behavior.

evidence.notes: StaticResourceCalloutMock is constructed and configured with a nondefault status, header, and static resource response.
StaticResourceCalloutMock constructs a local HttpCalloutMock used by Http.send.
Http.send supplies the runtime assertion; a concrete respond reference is unreachable and exists only as a target-specific source witness.
StaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured Content-Type header.
StaticResourceCalloutMock maps the Single_Response static resource to the response body.
StaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured Single Status text.
StaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured nondefault 203 status code.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock is constructed and configured with two endpoint-specific resources.
Http.send supplies the runtime assertion; a concrete respond reference is unreachable and exists only as a target-specific source witness.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured text/plain Content-Type header.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock maps two request endpoints to Response_A and Response_B.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured Multi Status text.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock returns the configured nondefault 204 status code.
